summary: KE Holdings filed a Form 6-K with five Next Day Disclosure Returns covering share repurchases made between May and October 2026. The exhibits list purchases of its WVR ordinary shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange between roughly HKD 36.08 and HKD 45.01 per share, and US-listed shares at about USD 5.72 per share, all executed on-market and held as repurchased-but-not-cancelled shares. The board authorised the buyback programme; no advisor is named. The filing is a routine disclosure of an on-market repurchase programme; watch for cancellation timing, daily buyback pace and the effect on treasury share overhang.
